action_items: No blocking issues — iteration 26 ships as-is.

OPTIONAL: routine tasks are re-created every time /shifts/start runs against a template on the same date, which can pile up duplicates (planner showed ['Medication','Walk','Medication'] after two shift-start cycles). Consider de-duping by (title, date, template_id) or removing old shift-type tasks on shift end. Low priority — cosmetic planner clutter, not called out in the spec.
OPTIONAL (carry-over from iter 25): migrate shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1976-1997 ShiftTemplateBody + _template_out cleanly recompute preview_subtotal/gst/total on every list/create/update — no stale totals possible. Uses the same compute_invoice_totals helper as invoices so maths stays consistent.

server.py:1815-1843 /shifts/start correctly auto-appends template.client_id to client_ids (if missing) BEFORE _create_shift_drafts, so a template-only start (client_ids=[]) still creates the pre-filled draft for the template's participant. Good.

server.py:1875-1906 _create_shift_drafts only applies template line items when template.client_id == current cid — so multi-client shifts won't accidentally pre-fill the wrong participant's invoice with the template's codes. Correct.

server.py:1952-1959 DELETE /shifts/{id} wipes draft invoices attached to the shift but preserves sent/paid ones — good safety net when a planned shift is cancelled after some invoicing already happened.
server.py:2010-2042 shift-template CRUD is fully org-scoped via _oid_org(template_id, org) → org isolation verified via pytest (demo cannot see owner templates).
frontend/app/(tabs)/shift.tsx:64 canGo = selected.length > 0 || !!selTemplate ← correctly enables Start/Plan CTA when only a template is chosen (zero participants), matching the spec.
frontend/app/(tabs)/shift.tsx:131-136 activeTemplate.trip_stops render conditionally with TripPlan below the live banner — clean composition.
frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:238-256 dashboard renders current-shift-cta ABOVE start-shift-cta when on shift, both use the same style.startShift class — visually consistent (green vs brand accent).

ShiftTemplateEditor.tsx:26-29 fmtTime is a tiny pure helper — strips non-digits and inserts ':' after 2 chars. Handles '0900' → '09:00' and '900' → '9:00' correctly. Preserves partial input during typing (< 3 chars stays raw).
ShiftTemplateEditor.tsx:98 total = items × 1.1 mirrors the backend 10% GST calc — matches server preview_total to the cent (verified 3 × 65.47 × 1.10 = 216.051 → both round to 216.05).

No files exceed 700 lines (server.py 2970 lines is monolithic but hasn't grown this iteration outside the ~80-line template section; shift.tsx 395, ShiftTemplateEditor.tsx 301, TripPlan.tsx 53). Modular enough.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 26 fully verified. Owner TEST_USER_EMAIL fresh 14-day trial expires 21/07/2026 (unchanged). No active shift left in the org. If you re-run iteration_26_test.py you'll get 15/15 again — it creates+deletes its own client/template/shifts. Playwright tip: horizontally-scrollable ScrollView chips inside RN Modal (tpl-client-<id>) trigger 'Element is outside of the viewport' on Playwright's click even with force=True — use `page.eval_on_selector(sel, 'el => el.click()')` (JS click) to bypass the viewport gate. Same trick works for tpl-stop-icon-* and other chips. window.confirm dialogs from confirmAction() on web are auto-accepted via `page.on('dialog', ...)` — no in-app confirm sheet on web. The invoice count-based numbering (INV-100x) may produce duplicates across orgs — flagged in the review as not in scope. react-native-keyboard-controller is native-only (no-op on web) and does not affect UI testing.
